title: What the Rise of SIFs Signals for Indian Wealth
excerpt: The landscape of Indian wealth management is undergoing a structural shift. With the maturation of domestic capital pools, Systematic Investment Funds (SIFs) are no longer a niche strategy but a core component of legacy planning.

body.text: Historically, high-net-worth families in India leaned heavily on real estate and traditional fixed-income instruments. However, the last decade has seen a dramatic pivot towards structured financial products that offer both alpha generation and risk mitigation.
The modern Indian patriarch is looking beyond wealth preservation; they are demanding sophisticated structures that ensure multi-generational growth in a complex regulatory environment.
Understanding this shift requires a deep dive into the regulatory frameworks that have fostered this environment, particularly the recent SEBI guidelines aimed at enhancing transparency in AIFs.
